t.E476.agn: In 2017 EFSA raised the ADI from 7.5 to 25 mg/kg body weight and stated that exposure estimates did not exceed this value. In a 2022 follow-up opinion it concluded that the proposed extension of use to ice cream would not raise a safety concern.
t.E476.body: In the gut PGPR is split into free polyglycerols, polyricinoleic acid and ricinoleic acid; small polyglycerols are absorbed and excreted in urine, while larger ones are mostly excreted in faeces.
t.E476.prod: It is an emulsifier produced by esterifying polyglycerol with castor oil fatty acids.
t.E476.regx.0: Re-evaluated; ADI revised to 25 mg/kg body weight, exposure below the ADI.
t.E476.regx.1: Follow-up opinion: extension of use to ice cream does not raise a safety concern; tightening of impurity limits recommended.
t.E476.summary: An emulsifier (PGPR) produced from castor oil and glycerol. It improves the flow of chocolate and reduces the need for cocoa butter.
t.E476.what: It is an emulsifier that improves the flow of chocolate and keeps water-in-oil emulsions stable.
